coverage_override.reason: Complete adversarial effect-by-effect re-review of every former CUSTOM_GAP on this card against current printed text, canonical Lua, Omega constants/helpers, and official database/scripts; all other PASS/FIXED records were preserved.

effects.printed_clause: Target your Nautica and an opponent monster; return both, then the opponent Normal or Special Summons a hand monster in Attack Position with ATK 0. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Adversarial re-review confirmed that the current canonical Lua implements this printed effect with supported Omega primitives. A compound effect need not have a single-card official analogue; the attached official references validate its individual engine structures.

official_references.matched_structure: Performs an effect-driven Normal Summon after a prior resolving action.
official_references.official_effect_text: If this face-up card would leave the field, [b]banish[/b] it [b]instead[/b]. [b]You can[/b] only use each of the following effects of "Floowandereeze & Robina" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b], [b]and[/b] [b]cannot[/b] Special Summon during the turn you activate either effect. If this card is Normal Summoned: [b]You can[/b] add 1 Level 4 or lower Winged Beast monster from your Deck to your hand, [b]then[/b] [b]immediately[/b] after this effect resolves, [b]you can[/b] Normal Summon 1 Winged Beast monster. If a Winged Beast monster is Normal Summoned to your field while this card is banished: [b]You can[/b] add this card to your hand.

official_references.matched_structure: Performs an effect-driven Special Summon to a specified player's field.
official_references.official_effect_text: Special Summon 1 monster from your Graveyard to your opponent's side of the field in Defense Position, [b]and[/b] increase the Level of 1 monster you control by the Level of the Special Summoned monster, until the [b]End Phase[/b].

effects.printed_clause: If your WATER Monster is Xyz Summoned while this is in the GY: attach this card as material, but banish it when detached. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed GY trigger targets a newly Xyz Summoned WATER Monster and overlays this card. The host receives an overlay-to-GY redirect limited to this exact material when its move reason is effect or cost and not REASON_RULE; ordinary material cleanup when the host leaves the field therefore no longer banishes it.

official_references.matched_structure: Attaches a Spell/Trap from the GY to an Xyz Monster as material.
official_references.official_effect_text: [b]Target[/b] 1 Xyz Monster in your GY; Special Summon it, [b]and if you do[/b], attach this card to it as material.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses an overlay-zone EFFECT_TO_GRAVE_REDIRECT to banish a designated Xyz Material instead of sending it to the GY.
official_references.official_effect_text: [b]Cannot[/b] be destroyed by battle. [b]When[/b] you take battle damage from an opponent's direct attack while this card is in your Graveyard: [b]You can[/b] Special Summon this card from your Graveyard in face-up Attack Position, [b]and if you do[/b], take 1000 damage. [b]You can[/b] only use this effect of "Gimmick Puppet Shadow Feeler" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b]. If this card is an Xyz Material [b]and[/b] would be sent to the Graveyard, [b]banish[/b] it [b]instead[/b].

effects.issue: Fixed the demonstrated overreach: REASON_RULE material cleanup when the host Xyz leaves the field no longer triggers the detach-only banish redirect.
